import heapq

def min_distance(N, K, x):
    # Calculate distances for type A and type B robots
    dist_A = [(abs(x[i] - 0), i + 1) for i in range(N)]
    dist_B = [(abs(x[i] - K), i + 1) for i in range(N)]
    
    # Sort distances for type A and type B robots
    dist_A.sort()
    dist_B.sort()
    
    # Use a priority queue to keep track of the minimum distance pairs
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (dist_A[0][0], dist_A[0][1], 'A'))
    heapq.heappush(pq, (dist_B[0][0], dist_B[0][1], 'B'))
    
    # Initialize variables to store the minimum distance and visited balls
    min_dist = float('inf')
    visited = set()
    
    while pq:
        current_dist, index, robot_type = heapq.heappop(pq)
        
        # Check if the ball has already been collected
        if index in visited:
            continue
        
        # Mark the ball as visited
        visited.add(index)
        
        # Update the minimum distance
        min_dist = min(min_dist, current_dist * 2)
        
        # If all balls have been collected, return the minimum distance
        if len(visited) == N:
            return min_dist
        
        # Add the next closest pair for the same type of robot
        if robot_type == 'A' and dist_A[1:]:
            heapq.heappush(pq, (dist_A[1][0], dist_A[1][1], 'A'))
            del dist_A[1]
        elif robot_type == 'B' and dist_B[1:]:
            heapq.heappush(pq, (dist_B[1][0], dist_B[1][1], 'B'))
            del dist_B[1]
